title: Toolchain prerequisites (first step)
description: Idempotent bootstrap for this Mac: install the toolchain named in rust-toolchain.toml (a pinned name such as 1.89.0 is a separate rustup toolchain from 'stable'); MSRV probe first: scripts/msrv-probe.sh builds scripts/msrv-probe/ (a scratch crate outside the workspace listing every pinned dependency of DESIGN §2.6) with `cargo +<pin> check` and prints the highest declared rust-version and the crates that declare none (uniffi 0.32.2); if it fails, move the pin to the current stable and update DESIGN §2.6 in the same change (contract change to the design owner). Add Rust targets (aarch64-apple-ios, aarch64-apple-ios-sim, aarch64-linux-android, x86_64-linux-android, wasm32-unknown-unknown); check cargo-ndk (present at ~/.cargo/bin, install ^4 only if missing); export ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_NDK_HOME=ndk/27.1.12297006, PATH += $ANDROID_HOME/cmake/3.22.1/bin (cmake+ninja for the Oboe shim), JAVA_HOME from /usr/libexec/java_home -v 21, and the cc-crate cross variables CC_/AR_ for aarch64-linux-android and x86_64-linux-android plus CARGO_TARGET_*_LINKER (API 31 clang, llvm-ar); corepack/pnpm check; call `cargo xtask fetch-opus` only when xtask exists; when apps/mobile exists run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm --filter @meshapp/mobile exec playwright install chromium`. Never requires system cmake, wasm-bindgen-cli, wasm-pack or uniffi-bindgen. doctor.sh prints missing items with a fix-it line (incl. Playwright Chromium and the MSRV report) and never installs. pick-sim.sh prints the UDID of an available iPhone simulator via `xcrun simctl list devices available -j` (never hard-coded names). DESIGN.md §2.2, §2.6.
interfaces: scripts/env.sh exports ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_NDK_HOME, JAVA_HOME (21), PATH with SDK cmake 3.22.1, CC_aarch64_linux_android, AR_aarch64_linux_android, CC_x86_64_linux_android, AR_x86_64_linux_android, CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_LINUX_ANDROID_LINKER, CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_LINUX_ANDROID_LINKER; sourcing it is side-effect free
scripts/pick-sim.sh prints exactly one simulator UDID on stdout, exit 1 if none
scripts/msrv-probe.sh exits non-zero if the pinned dependency set does not build with the pinned toolchain; scripts/msrv-probe/Cargo.toml is the pin list WP-01 copies into [workspace.dependencies]
rust-toolchain.toml: channel = the probed pin (1.89.0 if the probe passes) + the six targets + rustfmt, clippy
.cargo/config.toml: alias xtask = 'run -p xtask --'; [target.wasm32-unknown-unknown] rustflags getrandom_backend="wasm_js"; NDK linker fallbacks for aarch64/x86_64-linux-android (API 31)
acceptance: bootstrap.sh runs twice without error and without re-installing anything the second time
the pinned toolchain and all six Rust targets installed
msrv-probe.sh passes with the pinned toolchain (or the pin was moved and DESIGN §2.6 updated)
doctor.sh exits 0 on this Mac after bootstrap
pick-sim.sh returns a UDID that xcrun simctl recognizes
verify: xcrun simctl list devices | grep -q "$(bash scripts/pick-sim.sh)"

title: Monorepo scaffold, task runner, xtask skeleton, CI

resolver 3; [workspace.dependencies] exact pins copied from scripts/msrv-probe/Cargo.toml (DESIGN §2.6), checked equal by `cargo xtask check`; release profile §2.3; [workspace.lints.clippy] disallowed_methods = 'allow', disallowed_types = 'allow'), clippy.toml disallowed-methods/types list for determinism (§3.1; the lint is denied only by `#![deny]` in the seven sans-IO crates), STUB CRATES for every workspace member (crates/mesh-api, mesh-wire, mesh-crypto, mesh-lab, opus-sys, mesh-voice, mesh-routing, mesh-core, mesh-sim, mesh-ffi, mesh-wasm: Cargo.toml with the DESIGN §3.1 edges and features (mesh-voice 'opus' optional and not default; mesh-core default ['opus']; mesh-sim and mesh-wasm use mesh-core with default-features = false) + empty src/lib.rs (with the #![deny] line in sans-IO crates)); ownership of each stub crate passes to its WP at creation (stub hand-off), uniffi.toml, .gitignore (target/, build/, node_modules/, dist/, third_party/opus/opus-1.6.1/, native/ios/MeshEngineKit/Frameworks/, jniLibs/), scripts/tasks.mjs (single runner with --dry-run: rust/ios/android/cap/lab/doctor/ci groups; `pnpm run ci` = DESIGN §2.5 exactly), tools/uniffi-bindgen (one-line main), xtask main with dispatch table and STUB files ts.rs, vectors.rs, opus.rs, ios.rs, android.rs, bindings.rs, wasm.rs that return 'not implemented (owned by WP-xx)' with exit 1 — except the fetch-opus entry of opus.rs, which prints 'nothing to fetch' and exits 0 so every verify can call it from day 1 — after creation those stub files belong to the named WPs. check.rs: fmt + clippy + determinism grep over the seven sans-IO crates + pin-list equality with scripts/msrv-probe + (once mesh-wasm builds) the wasm getrandom tree check. GitHub Actions workflow mirroring `pnpm run ci` on macOS arm64 (best effort); the fuzz job is a separate nightly workflow that fails loudly. Lockfiles are tool-generated: any WP may regenerate them with pnpm install / cargo; conflicts are resolved by re-running the tool, never by hand edits.

title: Crypto (mesh-crypto)
description: Per-group identities (Ed25519 + X25519, id_hash, node_id), invite v1 codec (current epoch secret, policy, optional expiry, name in UTF-8 bytes, invite_sig over group_id ‖ epoch ‖ policy ‖ name ‖ leader_ed_pk ‖ SHA-256(epoch_secret), base64url fragment URL convlinkvoice://join?v=1#...), HKDF key schedule (psk_e, disc_key_e, group_tag, node_token with t10±1 for every retained epoch, aware_pmk, tunnel_rdv, lab_tag), Noise_XXpsk1_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256 over snow built with default-features = false and our own CryptoResolver (X25519/ChaChaPoly/SHA-256 from the pinned crates, randomness from the injected ChaCha20Rng; dalek crates without rand_core/getrandom features) with prologue binding; transport keys via HandshakeState::dangerously_get_raw_split() and SEC sealing with the chacha20poly1305 crate (nonce 0^4 ‖ u64(kp_ctr), AAD lf_type ‖ kp_ctr), in-band key update (HKDF 'cvic/v1/keyupdate', phase bit, old key kept 10 s), 1024-bit replay window per direction and phase updated only after tag verification, IDPROOF sign/verify with channel binding, ROSTER (with ed_pk per entry and invite_sig)/JOIN_REQ/GROUP_CTL (close, transfer-leader)/LEAVE/RIDE_CTL signing, REKEY sealing/opening with fresh ephemeral, monotonic acceptance helpers (roster_version strictly greater, new_epoch > epoch with an entry for me, ctl_version strictly greater), retained-epoch keyring (last 4), deny list. Crypto vectors into test-vectors/crypto/. No OS randomness anywhere in the crate.
interfaces: C8: mesh_crypto::{GroupIdentity, Invite, InviteSig, KeySchedule, EpochKeyring (retained epochs), LinkSession (initiator/responder state machine yielding HS bytes, then seal/open with key phases), ReplayWindow, IdProof, Roster, JoinReq, Rekey, GroupCtl, SignedLeave, SignedRideCtl, accept::{roster, rekey, group_ctl} monotonic checks, MeshResolver, vectors::generate()}

acceptance: HKDF/HMAC KATs; handshake between two in-memory peers; wrong PSK/epoch rejected at msg1 without revealing a static key
a flipped lf_type or kp_ctr byte fails the tag; raw-split keys and first SEC frame per direction match golden vectors

replay window proptest: no accept twice, no state change on forged frames

title: Routing, floor, pacing, presence (mesh-routing)
description: Neighbor table with link bundles and q formula, congested flag (drops/WouldBlock only; a cap below S_MAX is not congestion), NBR build/ingest (on change <=4 Hz, 1 s heartbeat, fresh <1.5 s; vcap informational), forwarding per DESIGN §5.2 with first-hop origin check and penalties, dedup windows per (origin, sess) after auth only (§5.3), 2-hop pruning for ctrl/bulk classes only — voice is never pruned (§5.4), TTL/age rules, per-link priority queues, stream-level shedding, delay-based pacer, cost model cost(k) = k × r_stream + 3 kbps (§4.8), voice-aware node BLE airtime budget (180 kbps; idle links granted 8 kbps; only voice links scaled) (§5.6), cap_pacing = max k with cost(k) <= 0.9 × grant and publication hysteresis (down after 2 s, up after 5 s), PATH_HINT trigger, link selection policy (BLE target 2 / max 3 from Limits, LimitReached backoff −1 for 10 min, articulation check, speculative link to an epoch-ahead peer at lowest priority), floor table with total rank (prio, t_origin from age + burst-relative ts/elapsed + hash smear T_TIE, origin), T_STICKY, per-link admission, near-talker rejection, reachability/who-hears-me/one-way/islands, voice reach classes (kpi ≤ 2 BLE hops, bestEffort 3-4 hops in TTL/age), position math.
